title: std::deque<T,Allocator>::~deque
summary: A destructor. Destructs the deque. The destructors of the elements are called and the used storage is deallocated. Note, that if the elements are pointers, the pointed-to objects are not destroyed.
html:
~deque();

A destructor. Destructs the deque. The destructors of the elements are called and the used storage is deallocated. Note, that if the elements are pointers, the pointed-to objects are not destroyed.

Complexity

Linear in the size of the deque.
